'''Niels A.J. Obers''' (born March 22, 1966, Nijmegen, Netherlands) is a Dutch theoretical physicist known for his contributions to [[conformal field theory]], [[string theory]], higher-dimensional [[black holes]] and [[holography]]. He is a Professor of Theoretical Physics at the [[Niels Bohr Institute]], [[University of Copenhagen]], and was Director of [[Nordita]], the Nordic Institute for Theoretical Physics, from 2019 to 2023.<ref>{{cite web |title=Obers appointed Director of Nordita |url=https://nordita.org/news/2019/obers-director.html |website=Nordita |date=2019-01-10}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Obers was born in Nijmegen, Netherlands, and received his undergraduate education in physics at [[Radboud University Nijmegen]], graduating ''cum laude'' in 1987. He earned an M.A. in physics in 1989 and completed his Ph.D. in theoretical physics at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1991 under the supervision of [[Martin B. Halpern]].

== Academic career ==
After his doctorate, Obers held postdoctoral and research positions at the [[University of Bonn]], [[École Polytechnique]], [[CERN]], and [[Nordita]]. From 2000 to 2002, he was an assistant professor at [[Utrecht University]] and [[Amsterdam University]]. In 2002, he joined the [[Niels Bohr Institute]] as an associate professor and was promoted to full professor in 2012. He has chaired the Theoretical Particle Physics and Cosmology section and served as Deputy Head and Acting Head of Department. From 2019 to 2023, Obers served as Director of [[Nordita]].

=== Research ===
Obers is known for his work on irrational conformal field theory,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Halpern |first1=M.B. |last2=Kiritsis |first2=E. |last3=Obers |first3=N.A. |last4=Clubok |first4=K. |title=Irrational conformal field theory |journal=Physics Reports |volume=265 |issue=1–2 |year=1996 |pages=1–138 |doi=10.1016/0370-1573(95)00017-8 |arxiv=hep-th/9501144}}</ref> non-perturbative dualities in string theory (notably U-duality),<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Obers |first1=N.A. |last2=Pioline |first2=B. |title=U-duality and M-theory |journal=Physics Reports |volume=318 |year=1999 |pages=113–225 |doi=10.1016/S0370-1573(99)00004-6 |arxiv=hep-th/9809039}}</ref> and the dynamics of black holes and black branes via the blackfold approach,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Emparan |first1=R. |last2=Harmark |first2=T. |last3=Niarchos |first3=V. |last4=Obers |first4=N.A. |title=World-Volume Effective Theory for Higher-Dimensional Black Holes |journal=Physical Review Letters |volume=102 |year=2009 |article-number=191301 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.102.191301 |arxiv=0902.0427}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Harmark |first1=T. |last2=Niarchos |first2=V. |last3=Obers |first3=N.A. |title=Instabilities of black strings and branes |journal=Classical and Quantum Gravity |volume=24 |year=2007 |pages=R1–R90 |doi=10.1088/0264-9381/24/24/R01 |arxiv=hep-th/0701022}}</ref> as well as for developing non-relativistic gravity, string theory, and holography using [[Newton–Cartan theory|Newton–Cartan geometry]] and related non-Lorentzian structures.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Harmark |first1=T. |last2=Hartong |first2=J. |last3=Obers |first3=N.A. |title=Non-Relativistic Strings and Limits of the AdS/CFT Correspondence |journal=Physical Review D |volume=96 |year=2017 |article-number=086019 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevD.96.086019 |arxiv=1705.03535}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Hansen |first1=D. |last2=Hartong |first2=J. |last3=Obers |first3=N.A. |title=Action Principle for Newtonian Gravity |journal=Physical Review Letters |volume=122 |year=2019 |article-number=061106 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.122.061106 |arxiv=1807.04765}}</ref> His research spans a broad range of topics in theoretical high-energy physics and gravitation.

=== Scientific service and grants ===
Obers has been principal investigator or co-investigator on major national and European research grants and has been representative of Denmark for several EU COST actions. He is a co-principal investigator of the [[Center of Gravity (Denmark)|Center of Gravity (CoG)]], a Danish National Research Foundation Center of Excellence hosted at the [[Niels Bohr Institute]] since September 2025.<ref>{{cite web |title=The Center of Gravity — Team |url=https://the-center-of-gravity.com/team/ |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Center of Gravity (CoG): a new DNRF Center of Excellence at NBI |url=https://nbi.ku.dk/english/news/happening-at-nbi/center-of-gravity-cog-a-new-dnrf-center-of-excellence-at-nbi/ |website=Niels Bohr Institute |date=2024-10-01 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref>

=== Public engagement ===
Obers is active in science outreach and public communication. He has delivered public lectures on black holes, [[gravitational waves]], and [[cosmology]] in Denmark and abroad. He has appeared on Danish television and radio, including [[DR (broadcaster)|DR]] and [[TV 2 (Denmark)|TV2]], and in several podcasts.<ref>{{cite web |title=Big Bang – ny forskning forklarer verdens begyndelse |url=http://livsstil.tv2.dk/2014-03-19-big-bang-ny-forskning-forklarer-verdens-begyndelse |website=TV2 News |date=2014-03-18 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Big Bang challenged – Cyclic Cosmology |url=https://www.sciencestories.dk/en/articles/big-bang-challenged-conformal-cyclic-cosmology |website=Science Stories |date=2021-02-12 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=The Anthropic Principle |url=https://soundcloud.com/science_stories/the-anthropic-principle |website=SoundCloud |date=2021-05-14 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Entanglement |url=https://soundcloud.com/science_stories/entanglement |website=SoundCloud |date=2022-11-04 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ubegribeligt: Tid |url=https://www.dr.dk/lyd/special-radio/ubegribeligt/ubegribeligt-2022/ubegribeligt-tid-11162220226 |website=DR |date=2023-05-15 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Gravitational waves — Science Stories |url=https://www.sciencestories.dk/en/articles/gravitational-waves |website=Science Stories |date=2024-05-31 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Einstein Telescope |url=https://www.sciencestories.dk/en/articles/einstein-telescope |website=Science Stories |date=2025-10-01 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref>

He has written several popular science articles in Danish.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Harmark |first1=Troels |last2=Obers |first2=Niels A. |title=Nye dimensioner for sorte huller |journal=Kvant |volume=19 |issue=4 |year=2008 |pages=3–7 |language=da |url=https://www.skivebibliotek.dk/work/work-of%3A870971-tsart%3A33432461 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Obers |first=Niels |title=Big Bang: ny opdagelse udløser eufori |work=Politiken |date=2014-05-02 |language=da |url=https://bibliotek.dk/materiale/big-bang-ny-opdagelse-udloeser-eufori_niels-obers/work-of%3A870971-avis%3A36032316 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Tyngdebølger — ekstramateriale (PDF) |url=https://aktuelnaturvidenskab.dk/fileadmin/Aktuel_Naturvidenskab/nr-6/AN6-2017tyngebolge-med-ekstramateriale.pdf |website=Aktuel Naturvidenskab |date=2017-12-08 |language=da |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Harmark |first1=Troels |last2=Obers |first2=Niels A. |title=Sorte huller |journal=Kvant |volume=35 |issue=1 |year=2024 |pages=3–6 |language=da |url=https://helsbib.dk/work/work-of%3A870971-tsart%3A138470156 |access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref>

=== Selected publications ===
* M.B. Halpern, E. Kiritsis, N.A. Obers, and K. Clubok, "Irrational Conformal Field Theory," ''Phys. Rep.'' 265 (1996) 1–144, [https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/9501144 arXiv:hep-th/9501144]
* N.A. Obers and B. Pioline, "U-duality and M-theory," ''Phys. Rep.'' 318 (1999) 113–225, [https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/9809039 arXiv:hep-th/9809039]
* T. Harmark, V. Niarchos, and N.A. Obers, "Instabilities of black strings and branes," ''Class. Quant. Grav.'' 24 (2007) R1–R90, [https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0701022 arXiv:hep-th/0701022]
* D. Hansen, J. Hartong, and N.A. Obers, "Action Principle for Newtonian Gravity," ''Phys. Rev. Lett.'' 122 (2019) 061106, [https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.04765 arXiv:1807.04765]
* J. de Boer, J. Hartong, N.A. Obers, W. Sybesma, and S. Vandoren, "Carroll Symmetry, Dark Energy and Inflation," ''Front. Phys.'' 10 (2022) 810405, [https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.02319 arXiv:2110.02319]
